# Goldsky

> Goldsky is the real-time blockchain data platform for fintech and crypto teams. Resilient infrastructure for RPCs, indexing, streaming, and orchestrating on-chain data with sub-second latency across 150+ chains.

Goldsky serves thousands of teams from startups to publicly traded enterprises including Coinbase, Phantom, Kraken, Polymarket, Ripple, Consensys, and Uniswap.

- Documentation: https://docs.goldsky.com
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://docs.goldsky.com/llms.txt): Complete list of all documentation pages
- Dashboard: https://app.goldsky.com
- [Supported chains](https://goldsky.com/chains): 150+ blockchain networks including Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, Stellar, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Unichain, Berachain, Zora, Linea, Scroll, zkSync Era, Avalanche, BNB Smart Chain, Starknet, NEAR, Sui, Arweave, TRON, Hedera, and many more.
- [Pricing](https://goldsky.com/pricing): Free tier, pay-as-you-go, and enterprise plans.

## Products

Goldsky offers five products that work independently or together:

- [Turbo Pipelines](https://docs.goldsky.com/turbo-pipelines/introduction): High-throughput blockchain data streaming pipelines. Rust engine with vectorized (SIMD) execution, microsecond-level processing, hot-reloading deployments, live data previews, local debugging, TypeScript/SQL/HTTP transforms, dynamic tables, and first-class Solana support with full historical replay from genesis.
- [Mirror](https://docs.goldsky.com/mirror/introduction): Stream blockchain data directly into your database in real-time. Sub-second latency, 15+ sinks (PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Elasticsearch, Kafka, S3, DynamoDB), elastic compute, self-healing reorg handling, snapshots, and email alerts.
- [Subgraphs](https://docs.goldsky.com/subgraphs/introduction): Managed GraphQL APIs for blockchain data. Compatible with The Graph, one-line migration, no-code instant subgraphs from contract ABIs, real-time webhooks, versioning and tagging, factory contract support, and cross-chain subgraphs via Mirror.
- [Edge RPC](https://docs.goldsky.com/edge-rpc/introduction): High-performance RPC proxy built on open-source eRPC. Sub-50ms latency from 8+ edge regions, automatic failover, and data integrity cross-validation.
- [Compose (coming soon)](https://docs.goldsky.com/compose/introduction): Offchain-to-onchain execution framework. Durable TypeScript workflows in verifiable sandboxes with TEE support, traceable function calls, built-in wallets, and cron/event/HTTP triggers. For oracles, keepers, circuit breakers, and cross-chain coordination.

## Quick-start paths

- **I want blockchain data in my database** → Use Mirror or Turbo Pipelines. See https://docs.goldsky.com/mirror/create-a-pipeline or https://docs.goldsky.com/turbo-pipelines/quickstart
- **I want a GraphQL API to query blockchain data** → Use Subgraphs. See https://docs.goldsky.com/subgraphs/deploying-subgraphs
- **I want reliable RPC endpoints** → Use Edge RPC. See https://docs.goldsky.com/edge-rpc/quickstart
- **I want to automate and orchestrate onchain tasks** → Use Compose. See https://docs.goldsky.com/compose/quick-start
- **I need Solana data** → Use Turbo Pipelines. See https://docs.goldsky.com/turbo-pipelines/sources/solana

## Getting Started

1. **Sign up**: https://app.goldsky.com/signup
2. **Install the Goldsky CLI**: `curl https://goldsky.com/cli-installation.sh | sh`
3. **Follow a quickstart**: Pick a path above or browse https://docs.goldsky.com

- [CLI installation guide](https://docs.goldsky.com/installation): Detailed install instructions and requirements
- [CLI reference](https://docs.goldsky.com/reference/cli): Complete command reference
